Class CraftTweakerText.CustomEffect

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerText.CustomEffect
Enclosing class:
CraftTweakerText
public static final class CraftTweakerText.CustomEffect extends Object
Named callbacks avoid channel-name typos; build consumes the draft exactly once.
